scope: Read-only functional contract audit requested by owner; app implementation, stages, registry statuses, workflows, release metadata and releases unchanged.
inventory_method: Inventory of all80 registry entries; static UI/persistence/primary-consumer tracing. Focused runtime adapters cover selected paths only; does not certify all branches, Apple SDK, server results or iPhone. Existing compile/device statuses are preserved.

findings.summary: Modern Gallery does not apply highQualityPhotos to ordinary library photo HD/quality. A saved20% survives when maximum quality is switched ON; native HD remains OFF. Legacy sender applies the flag correctly.
findings.expected: Maximum-quality ON selects HD and JPEG100% independently of hidden manual slider.
findings.observed: Actual library-photo builder yields forceHd=false and nil quality; actual fetch quality expression uses mediaSettings.jpegQuality20%.

findings.summary: Rendered/edited photo encoding uses fixed0.6 and has no manual photoQuality input; ordinary unedited library photos still read manual quality in fetch.
findings.expected: Selected manual JPEG quality applies to a photo sent as photo, including rendered/edited result.

findings.summary: Wide setting is consumed in common BubbleItemNode, but native dispatch sends stickers, dice and standalone large/animated emoji into separate sticker nodes that do not read it.
findings.expected: Owner explicitly requires wide channel post area for every message type while preserving media proportions.
findings.observed: Separate native renderers keep their own width; static dispatch/layout proof. Existing wide-post runtime fixture verifies bubble/media/mosaic paths only and does not cover this exception.

scope_notes.summary: Master OFF disables custom runtime, but ordinary Telegram Premium/trial/boost transcription button and native RPC path remain. This is a fact about scope, not an established breaking regression or authorization to change native Telegram behavior.
Manual translation stays available when automatic/custom master is OFF, per prior agreed manual-always behavior. Not counted as a bug.
